descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S15 「main 上的养老院病历接线（AI 是 mock 的）：Admission Summary 标签、New Admission → SNF admission、Save & Extract、SNF 计费代码、Medications 面板」 Nursing Home chart wiring on main (mocked AI): Admission Summary label, New Admission → SNF admission, Save & Extract, SNF billing code, Medications panel

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Nursing Home has Save & Extract, a billing block and a Medications panel, all working (none were present in Run 6)（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1c The summary label is 'Background Summary' in Hospital and 'Admission Summary' in Nursing Home（UAT TC-21 step 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U4 Default template: the admission-status badge pre-selects the template (New Admission → H&P / SNF admission, Follow-up → SOAP progress / SNF follow-up, Consult → Consult note / SNF consult), and the p …（UAT TC-21；UAT TC-21 step 1 (default template)；TFA-92599 AC 6；TFA-92599 rule 4；TFA-92584 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Tim's suite at e02167f; each test uses action-observer mocks, so no live AI and no E2E_AI_LIVE

When Run the four tests by title

Then The NH hub reaches every chart tab and shows 'Admission Summary' with no 'Background Summary'. New Admission pre-selects SNF admission. Save & Extract saves the notes, closes and adds tasks, and keeps a codeword task verbatim. A generated NH note requests and saves an SNF code. The parsed medications reach the NH Medications panel.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions, wiring only. The hub test also asserts that the NH card shows the resident's diagnosis, which contradicts UAT TC-03 (Q8; TC-01 Q4), so its Pass is no evidence for identity fields (U1b → S16). Its handoff check only proves the 'Handoff Summary' heading is reachable (U8 → S18). …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-21/S15

Nursing Home chart wiring on main (mocked AI): Admission Summary label, New Admission → SNF admission, Save & Extract, SNF billing code, Medications panel

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-21.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • billing-suggestion.spec.ts [chromium] — a generated Nursing Home note requests and saves an SNF code — expected
  • medication-tracker-snf.spec.ts [chromium] — the parsed medications reach the Nursing Home panel — expected
  • navigation.spec.ts [chromium] — the nursing-home hub reaches add, scan, inbox, task export, handoff, settings, and every chart tab — expected
  • snf-save-extract.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract saves the notes, closes and adds tasks, and keeps a codeword task verbatim — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: Tim's Nursing Home specs run on their own fixture accounts made through e2e/support/backend.ts (admin key) and answer every AI call with action-observer mocks; dev has one shared account, no admin key and no action mock, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
